title: NetworkDocumentReceivedPayload
description: Payload of the NetworkDocumentReceived event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

adapter.description: The Access Point adapter that received the document.

supplierDocUuid.description: The supplier's Doc UUID, where the supplier is on this platform.

documentReference.description: Reference to the received document's stored bytes.
